sentiment.rationale: AWS growth accelerated to 28% (fastest in 15 quarters) on a $150B run rate, with a $364B backlog before the $100B+ Anthropic deal. Operating margin hit a record 13.1%. Q2 guidance was raised to $194B-$199B revenue and $20B-$24B operating income, well above consensus. Cost pressures (memory, transport, LEO) are acknowledged but framed as manageable against the strong demand backdrop.

summary.guidance: Q2 net sales expected between $194B and $199B; Q2 operating income expected between $20B and $24B.
summary.margin: Operating income $23.9B at a 13.1% margin, the highest ever.
key_risks: Memory component costs have skyrocketed and supply volatility threatens capacity.
Higher transport and fuel costs plus about $1B of LEO expense pressure Q2 margins.
Rapid capex growth constrains free cash flow until the infrastructure monetizes.
key_opportunities: AWS growth accelerated to 28% year-over-year, fastest in 15 quarters, with a $364B backlog.
AI revenue growing triple digits year-over-year; Trainium2 has 30% better price performance than comparable GPUs.
Amazon Leo commercial service on track to launch in Q3 with meaningful revenue commitments.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Andy Jassy described the quarter as 'a strong quarter for Amazon' and stated 'we have high confidence this will be monetized well' regarding CapEx investments.
